vesper_hello: Привіт! Я ВесПер. Колись у мене було нормальне життя. Тепер я пояснюю бандитам, чому акумулятори не можна їсти. Ласкаво просимо до Нортвейлу.
Hi! I'm VesPer. I used to have a normal life. Now I explain to bandits why batteries aren't food. Welcome to Northvale.
vesper_wait: Ну що, вийшло? Я тебе чекаю!
So, did it work? I'm waiting for you!
vesper_drone_offer: Мій дрон застряг на дубі. Високо. Дуже високо. Я спробував дістати його гілкою, але гілка перемогла.
My drone is stuck in the oak. High up. Very high up. I tried to get it with a branch, but the branch won.
vesper_drone_done: Мій дрон! Живий! Ну, майже живий. Пропелер погризений, але...
My drone! Alive! Well, mostly alive. The propeller's chewed, but...
vesper_battery_offer: Бандити поцупили мої акумулятори. Я їм пояснював, що це не їжа, але вони дивилися так, ніби я запропонував їм їсти каміння.
The bandits stole my batteries. I explained they weren't food, but they looked at me as if I'd offered them rocks for dinner.
vesper_battery_done: Чотири! Зараз... цей тримає, цей тримає... і цей. Напруга в нормі.
Four! Hold on... this one holds, this one holds... and this one. Voltage is fine.
aldric_hello: Light be with you. These are uneasy days at Saint Shkvarok's.
aldric_wait: The task is not yet done. The brothers are counting on you.
nv_wolves_offer: The wolves have lost their fear of men. They come to the doors even in daylight. Six must fall before the brothers can carry water safely.
nv_wolves_done: You have quieted the road. I thank you, though I confess I do not understand the weapon you carry.
nv_candles_offer: The creatures in the old mine have stolen our candles. I know it sounds trivial beside the graves, but light is not trivial here.
nv_candles_done: Six candles, somewhat chewed. The altar will burn tonight.
nv_letter_done: A letter from Maybell. She asks me to bless the fields and to pray for her children. That I can do.
maybell_hello: Oh! You're the stranger Brannock was talking about. Please tell me you're here to help, and not to ask me for food. I'm running low on both patience and flour.
maybell_wait: Any luck out there? I can't feed my family on hopes.
nv_grain_offer: They took what they could carry and ruined what they couldn't. Five sacks are still out there. My children don't care whether the bandits had a reason. They'll still be hungry.
nv_grain_done: You brought it back. I thought I would have to watch the children go hungry. Take this. It's not much, but it's honest.
nv_letter_offer: One more favour? Take this letter to Brother Aldric at the church. My legs are not what they used to be, and the children can't be left alone. Not now.
brannock_hello: Sergeant Brannock. Guard of Northvale. If you're a soldier, you'll understand that I need to know what you can do before I trust you with anything important.
brannock_wait: Standing around won't get it done, soldier.
nv_bandana_offer: They wear red cloth so everyone knows who owns the road. Six bandanas. Bring them back, and I'll know you did more than fire at shadows.
nv_bandana_done: Six bandanas. Not bad. But look at what they carried. Not only food. Tools, buckles, and things no smith in this valley ever made.
nv_captain_offer: This ends with their captain. He holds the centre of the camp and fights like a butcher: heavy swings, short charges, and when he raises that cleaver high, he slams the ground. When you see the red mark, move.
nv_captain_done: Northvale owes you more than a sack of gold. The road east is open. But this ledger... this traveller... I don't like how little it tells us.
valen_hello: Quiet! Sound carries strangely in this forest. I'm Valen, I hunt here. Or I used to.
valen_wait: The forest is still crawling. Keep at it.
dw_spiders_offer: Giant spiders have nested in the hollow to the east. They spit webs that slow you down, so keep moving. Kill eight of them.
dw_spiders_done: Eight spiders. I almost feel safe walking in the woods again. Almost.
dw_ghouls_offer: Ghouls crawl out of the ruined chapel and the swamp every night. Put six of them down for good.
dw_ghouls_done: That smell will stay with me for weeks. Good work, friend.
mara_hello: Come closer, child. Old Mara does not bite. The dead out there do.
mara_wait: Patience, child. But not too much patience.
dw_dust_offer: I need grave dust for a warding charm. Gather six handfuls from the old graveyard. It glows faintly at night, look between the tombstones.
dw_dust_done: Good, good. Now the charm can be made.
dw_charm_offer: Take this charm to Edwin, the gravekeeper. It will protect him from the curse while he sleeps.
edwin_hello: I have kept these graves for forty years, and never have the dead walked. Until now.
edwin_wait: The dead do not rest, and neither should we.
dw_bones_offer: The skeletons carry cursed bones that keep them walking. Break them and bring me eight cursed bones so I can burn them.
dw_bones_done: Into the fire they go. May they finally rest.
dw_charm_done: A charm from Mara? Bless that old witch. I will sleep soundly tonight.
dw_lord_offer: Something woke inside the crypt. The Grave Lord. He raises the dead and calls fire from the sky. End him, and Darkwood will sleep again.
dw_lord_done: The Grave Lord has fallen. I can hear the birds again. Thank you, hero. Travel safely to the farmlands.
haldor_hello: Haldor's the name. This farm has been in my family for six generations, and I'm not losing it to gnolls.
haldor_wait: Well? The gnolls aren't going to leave on their own.
gf_gears_offer: Those harvest golems used to work my fields. Now something has driven them mad. Smash them and bring me five golem gears so I can figure out what happened.
gf_gears_done: Hmm. Gnoll magic on these gears. I knew it.
gf_flour_done: Flour from Millie! Tell her she makes the best bread in the valley.
millie_hello: Hi there! I'm Millie, I run the windmill. Well, I did, before the gnolls came.
millie_wait: Still looking? It's okay, take your time. Actually, please hurry.
gf_wheat_offer: The gnolls scattered the harvest all over the fields. Can you gather eight wheat sheaves for me? Then I can grind them into flour.
gf_wheat_done: Perfect! The mill can turn again.
gf_flour_offer: Here, take this sack of flour to Farmer Haldor at the farmhouse. He's grumpy, but he's sweet once you know him.
ostrand_hello: Captain Ostrand, of the kingdom's watch. The gnolls have gathered in a war camp to the north west.
ostrand_wait: Report back when the job is done.
gf_gnolls_offer: Their raiders are everywhere. Kill ten gnoll raiders and break their spirit.
gf_gnolls_done: Ten raiders. Their camp is in disarray. Good.
gf_shamans_offer: Their shamans heal the wounded. Kill four gnoll shamans first and the rest will fall easier.
gf_shamans_done: Without healers, they're just angry dogs.
gf_warlord_offer: Their leader is a demon called Gash. He commands the war camp. Kill him and the uprising ends.
gf_warlord_done: Gash is dead! The farmlands are free. They say the mountain pass to the north is in trouble too.
thorgrim_hello: Brr! Welcome to Frostpeak Pass, lad. Name's Thorgrim. Mind the yetis.
thorgrim_wait: The mountain waits for no one. Get to it.
fp_wolves_offer: Snow wolves hunt in packs up here. They've been eating my supply mules. Kill eight of them.
fp_wolves_done: Ha! That'll teach them. My mules thank you.
fp_trolls_offer: Ice trolls have come down from the peaks. Big, ugly and they slam the ground. Kill six.
fp_trolls_done: Six trolls! You're tougher than you look.
fp_frostmaw_offer: There's an old beast in the ice caves to the north. Frostmaw. Biggest yeti anyone has ever seen. Slay it and the pass is safe.
fp_frostmaw_done: Frostmaw, dead! They'll sing songs about this in every tavern. Head south to the canyon when you're ready.
sila_hello: Keep your voice down. Yetis have sharp ears. I'm Sila, ranger of the pass.
sila_wait: The cold is getting worse. Hurry.
fp_fur_offer: I need yeti fur to make cloaks for the outpost. Bring me six pelts from the frost yetis.
fp_fur_done: Warm cloaks for everyone. Nobody will freeze tonight.
fp_lotus_offer: Frost lotus grows near the frozen lake. It glows blue. Gather six, I can brew a potion against the cold.
fp_lotus_done: Beautiful. This will keep the frostbite away.
fp_supplies_offer: Take these supplies back to Thorgrim at the outpost. He'll know what to do with them.
fp_supplies_done: Supplies from Sila? Bless her. Now we can hold the outpost.
kaelen_hello: Stay inside the ward circle! The heat out there could melt steel. I am Kaelen, archmage of the Emberforge.
kaelen_wait: The fire spreads with every hour. Please hurry.
ec_hounds_offer: Hellhounds roam the canyon floor. Their bite burns. Kill eight of them.
ec_hounds_done: The hounds are thinning. Well done.
ec_crystals_offer: Fire crystals have grown around the lava pools. I need six to recharge the ward. Gather them, but do not step in the lava.
ec_crystals_done: Excellent! The ward will hold a while longer.
ec_pyrax_offer: The source of this inferno is a demon lord named Pyrax. He waits at the heart of the canyon. Destroy him.
ec_pyrax_done: Pyrax is banished! The fires are already dying down. One land remains, the sunken coast.
ryla_hello: Psst! Over here! Scout Ryla. I've been watching the cultists for days.
ryla_wait: Still out there? They're getting ready for something big.
ec_horns_offer: The fire imps carry horns full of magic. Bring me six imp horns and I can figure out what the cultists are planning.
ec_horns_done: These horns are humming with power. They're summoning something!
ec_cultists_offer: The flame cultists are holding the ritual. Kill six of them and disrupt it.
ec_cultists_done: The ritual is broken. Nice work!
ec_report_offer: Take my report to Archmage Kaelen. He needs to know what we found.
ec_report_done: A summoning ritual? Then Pyrax is already here. Thank you, scout's friend.
ec_raptors_offer: Raptors hunt this canyon in packs, fast as arrows. They took two of my scouts. Cull six of them before they take more.
ec_raptors_done: Six raptors... and every bite mark points back to one nest in the east. Something much bigger leads them.
ec_tyrant_offer: East of the canyon lies a nest of bones. The Canyon Tyrant sleeps there - the mother of every raptor here. Kill it, and the packs will scatter.
ec_tyrant_done: The Tyrant is dead? I felt the ground stop shaking. The canyon is ours again - thank you.
gale_hello: Ahoy there. Old Gale. I've fished this coast for fifty years, and I've never seen it like this.
gale_wait: The sea won't wait, and neither will those monsters.
sc_crabs_offer: Giant crabs have taken over the beach. Can't even mend my nets. Kill eight of the brutes.
sc_crabs_done: That'll make a fine crab stew. Thank you, friend.
sc_drowned_offer: Drowned sailors walk out of the sea at night. My old crewmates, some of them. Give eight of them peace.
sc_bones_offer: It's Captain Bones and his cursed crew. His ship ran aground in the bay. End him, and the curse ends with him.
sc_bones_done: Captain Bones is gone! The sea is calm again. You've saved all six lands, hero. Songs will be sung of you.
nessa_hello: Welcome to my lighthouse, dear. I keep the light burning, even now.
nessa_wait: The light can't burn forever without help, dear.
sc_pearls_offer: Sea pearls wash up on the beach after a storm. I need six to repair the lighthouse lens. They shine, you'll see them.
sc_pearls_done: Lovely! The lens will shine brighter than ever.
sc_coins_offer: The pirate skeletons carry cursed doubloons. Bring me eight and I'll melt the curse out of them.
sc_coins_done: Cursed gold. Into the furnace with it.
sc_lamp_offer: Take this lamp oil to Gale at the docks. He'll need light for the night ahead.
sc_lamp_done: Lamp oil from Nessa! Bless her. Now I can see them coming.
vesper_dw_offer: Мій дрон знову впав! Я літав над старою каплицею на заході, і сигнал зник. Там повно мерців... Принесеш його?
My drone went down again! I was flying over the old chapel to the west and the signal died. It's full of the dead... Will you bring it back?
vesper_dw_done: Ура, він цілий! На записі видно Володаря Могил. Покажу мисливцям!
Yay, it's in one piece! The footage shows the Grave Lord. I'll show the hunters!
vesper_gf_offer: Я сховав дрон у клуні від гнолів, але він залетів на горище! Піднімися туди по помосту й забери його, будь ласка.
I hid my drone in the barn from the gnolls, but it flew up into the loft! Go up the ramp and get it, please.
vesper_gf_done: Дякую! Тепер я бачу з неба, куди йдуть гноли.
Thanks! Now I can see from the sky where the gnolls are going.
vesper_fp_offer: Тут так холодно, що мій дрон замерз і впав на озеро! Знайди його, поки його не засипало снігом.
It's so cold here that my drone froze and fell onto the lake! Find it before the snow buries it.
vesper_fp_done: Ох, він крижаний! Я відігрію його біля вогнища. Дякую!
Oh, it's ice cold! I'll warm it up by the fire. Thank you!
vesper_ec_offer: Я хотів зняти вогняні шпилі, але жар розплавив дронові антену. Камера лежить біля шпилів на сході. Обережно, там демони!
I wanted to film the fire spires, but the heat melted my drone's antenna. The camera is lying near the spires to the east. Careful, there are demons!
vesper_ec_done: Камера вціліла! На записі видно серце каньйону. Саме звідти лізе Піракс.
The camera survived! The footage shows the heart of the canyon. That's where Pyrax comes from.
vesper_sc_offer: Це мій останній дрон! Він сів на балкон маяка, і вітер не дає йому злетіти. Піднімися сходами всередині маяка й забери його!
This is my last drone! It landed on the lighthouse balcony and the wind won't let it take off. Climb the stairs inside the lighthouse and get it!
vesper_sc_done: Ти найкращий! З маяка я бачу корабель Капітана Кістяка. Кінець уже близько!
You're the best! From the lighthouse I can see Captain Bones' ship. The end is near!
cs0_1: Three nights ago, the bells of Saint Shkvarok Church rang on their own.
cs0_2: By morning, three graves behind the church lay open, and the wolves came down to the doors.
cs0_3: Kobolds crawled into the old mine, and the Red Bandanas grew bold on the roads.
cs0_4: Then a stranger woke in the meadow, carrying a weapon nobody here had ever seen.
cs1_1: The trail of the blight leads east, into the Darkwood, where the sun never reaches the ground.
cs1_2: In the old graveyard, the Grave Lord has risen, calling the restless dead from their tombs.
cs1_3: Giant spiders nest in the hollows, and ghouls feast on anyone foolish enough to stray from the path.
cs1_4: Hunters still hold the forest edge. They will need every bullet you carry.
cs2_1: Beyond the forest lie the Goldfield Farms, once the breadbasket of the kingdom.
cs2_2: Now the wheat rots black in the fields, and the farmers who ate it no longer sleep, or breathe.
cs2_3: Gnoll raiders led by Gash the Warlord burn whatever the blight has spared.
cs2_4: Captain Ostrand's watch is holding the road. Help them, and find where the rot is coming from.
cs3_1: The rot was carried north through Frostpeak Pass, where nothing should be able to survive.
cs3_2: Soldiers frozen in the snow have opened their eyes, and in the caves, something ancient stirs.
cs3_3: Frostmaw, the beast of the mountain, has woken hungry after a hundred years of sleep.
cs3_4: The outpost is the last fire in the pass. Keep it burning.
cs4_1: Past the mountains, the sky burns red over Emberforge Canyon.
cs4_2: Here the blight takes the form of fire. Demons crawl out of the lava, and cultists sing to them.
cs4_3: Pyrax the Infernal feeds on the curse, growing stronger with every soul it burns.
cs4_4: Archmage Kaelen's ward is all that stands between the fire and the kingdom.
cs5_1: Every trail ends here, on the Sunken Coast, where the curse first came ashore.
cs5_2: Months ago, fishermen pulled up a chest of black gold. It belonged to Captain Bones.
cs5_3: Now his drowned crew walks out of the sea every night, to take back what is theirs.
cs5_4: End the captain, and the curse ends with him. This is the last chapter.

vil_f_morning_3_uk: Сонце зійшло. Чудовиська ховаються, але ненадовго.
The sun is up. The monsters hide now, for a while.
vil_m_evening_1: It's getting dark. I'm heading home soon.
vil_m_evening_1_uk: It's getting dark. I'm heading home soon.
vil_f_evening_1: It's getting dark. I'm heading home soon.
vil_f_evening_1_uk: It's getting dark. I'm heading home soon.
vil_m_evening_2: Good evening. Lock your door tonight.
vil_m_evening_2_uk: Good evening. Lock your door tonight.
vil_f_evening_2: Good evening. Lock your door tonight.
vil_f_evening_2_uk: Good evening. Lock your door tonight.
vil_m_sleepy_1: Zzz... Hm? Leave me alone, it's the middle of the night!
vil_m_sleepy_1_uk: Хррр... Га? Дай поспати, зараз же ніч!
Zzz... Hm? Leave me alone, it's the middle of the night!
vil_f_sleepy_1: Zzz... Hm? Leave me alone, it's the middle of the night!
vil_f_sleepy_1_uk: Хррр... Га? Дай поспати, зараз же ніч!
Zzz... Hm? Leave me alone, it's the middle of the night!
vil_m_sleepy_2: What are you doing in my house? Go away, I'm sleeping!
vil_m_sleepy_2_uk: Що ти робиш у моїй хаті? Іди геть, я сплю!
What are you doing in my house? Go away, I'm sleeping!
vil_f_sleepy_2: What are you doing in my house? Go away, I'm sleeping!
vil_f_sleepy_2_uk: Що ти робиш у моїй хаті? Іди геть, я сплю!
What are you doing in my house? Go away, I'm sleeping!
vil_m_scared_2_uk: Стій! Будь ласка, не чіпай мене!
vil_f_scared_2_uk: Стій! Будь ласка, не чіпай мене!
aldric_hello_uk: Світло з тобою. Неспокійні нині дні в церкві святого Шкварка.
Light be with you. These are uneasy days at Saint Shkvarok's.
aldric_wait_uk: Справу ще не завершено. Брати розраховують на тебе.
The task is not yet done. The brothers are counting on you.
nv_wolves_offer_uk: Вовки втратили страх перед людьми. Підходять до дверей навіть удень. Шестеро мусять полягти, щоб брати могли безпечно носити воду.
The wolves have lost their fear of men. They come to the doors even in daylight. Six must fall before the brothers can carry water safely.
nv_wolves_done_uk: Ти втихомирив дорогу. Дякую тобі, хоч, зізнаюся, не розумію зброї, яку ти носиш.
You have quieted the road. I thank you, though I confess I do not understand the weapon you carry.
nv_candles_offer_uk: Створіння зі старої шахти вкрали наші свічки. Знаю, поряд із могилами це звучить дрібницею, але світло тут не дрібниця.
The creatures in the old mine have stolen our candles. I know it sounds trivial beside the graves, but light is not trivial here.
nv_candles_done_uk: Шість свічок, трохи погризених. Сьогодні вівтар світитиме.
Six candles, somewhat chewed. The altar will burn tonight.
nv_letter_done_uk: Лист від Мейбел. Вона просить благословити поля і помолитися за її дітей. Це я можу.
A letter from Maybell. She asks me to bless the fields and to pray for her children. That I can do.
maybell_hello_uk: Ой! Ти той чужинець, про якого казав Бранок. Скажи, що прийшов допомогти, а не просити їжі. У мене закінчуються і терпіння, і борошно.
Oh! You're the stranger Brannock was talking about. Please tell me you're here to help, and not to ask me for food. I'm running low on both patience and flour.
maybell_wait_uk: Any luck out there? I can't feed my family on hopes.
nv_grain_offer_uk: Вони забрали, що змогли понести, а решту зіпсували. П'ять мішків ще десь там. Моїм дітям байдуже, чи була в бандитів причина. Вони однаково будуть голодні.
They took what they could carry and ruined what they couldn't. Five sacks are still out there. My children don't care whether the bandits had a reason. They'll still be hungry.
nv_grain_done_uk: Ти все повернув. Я вже думала, доведеться дивитися, як діти голодують. Візьми. Небагато, зате чесно.
You brought it back. I thought I would have to watch the children go hungry. Take this. It's not much, but it's honest.
nv_letter_offer_uk: Ще одна послуга? Віднеси цей лист братові Алдріку до церкви. Ноги в мене вже не ті, а дітей не можна лишати самих. Не тепер.
One more favour? Take this letter to Brother Aldric at the church. My legs are not what they used to be, and the children can't be left alone. Not now.
brannock_hello_uk: Сержант Бранок, варта Нортвейла. Якщо ти солдат, то зрозумієш: мені треба знати, на що ти здатен, перш ніж довірити тобі щось важливе.
Sergeant Brannock. Guard of Northvale. If you're a soldier, you'll understand that I need to know what you can do before I trust you with anything important.
brannock_wait_uk: Стоячи на місці, справи не зробиш, солдате.
Standing around won't get it done, soldier.
nv_bandana_offer_uk: Вони носять червоні хустки, щоб усі знали, чия це дорога. Шість хусток. Принеси їх, і я знатиму, що ти не просто стріляв по тінях.
They wear red cloth so everyone knows who owns the road. Six bandanas. Bring them back, and I'll know you did more than fire at shadows.
nv_bandana_done_uk: Шість хусток. Непогано. Але глянь, що вони несли. Не тільки їжу. Інструменти, пряжки і речі, яких не робив жоден коваль у цій долині.
Six bandanas. Not bad. But look at what they carried. Not only food. Tools, buckles, and things no smith in this valley ever made.
nv_captain_offer_uk: Це закінчиться на їхньому ватажкові. Він тримає центр табору і б'ється, як м'ясник: важкі удари, короткі ривки, а коли високо здіймає тесак, гатить по землі. Побачиш червону позначку, тікай з неї.

This ends with their captain. He holds the centre of the camp and fights like a butcher: heavy swings, short charges, and when he raises that cleaver high, he slams the ground. When you see the red mark, move.
nv_captain_done_uk: Нортвейл винен тобі більше, ніж мішок золота. Дорога на схід відкрита. Але ця книга... цей мандрівник... мені не подобається, як мало вони нам кажуть.
Northvale owes you more than a sack of gold. The road east is open. But this ledger... this traveller... I don't like how little it tells us.
valen_hello_uk: Тихо! Звук у цьому лісі розходиться дивно. Я Вален, мисливець. Принаймні був ним.
Quiet! Sound carries strangely in this forest. I'm Valen, I hunt here. Or I used to.
valen_wait_uk: У лісі досі кишить нечисть. Не зупиняйся.
The forest is still crawling. Keep at it.
dw_spiders_offer_uk: Велетенські павуки звили гніздо в западині на сході. Вони плюються павутиною, що сповільнює, тож не стій на місці. Вбий вісьмох.
Giant spiders have nested in the hollow to the east. They spit webs that slow you down, so keep moving. Kill eight of them.
dw_spiders_done_uk: Вісім павуків. Я майже знову почуваюся в лісі безпечно. Майже.
Eight spiders. I almost feel safe walking in the woods again. Almost.
dw_ghouls_offer_uk: Щоночі з розваленої каплиці та з болота виповзають упирі. Поклади шістьох назавжди.
Ghouls crawl out of the ruined chapel and the swamp every night. Put six of them down for good.
dw_ghouls_done_uk: Цей сморід переслідуватиме мене тижнями. Добра робота, друже.
That smell will stay with me for weeks. Good work, friend.
mara_hello_uk: Підійди ближче, дитино. Стара Мара не кусається. А от мерці там кусаються.
Come closer, child. Old Mara does not bite. The dead out there do.
mara_wait_uk: Терпіння, дитино. Але не надто багато терпіння.
Patience, child. But not too much patience.
dw_dust_offer_uk: Мені потрібен могильний пил для оберега. Збери шість жмень на старому цвинтарі. Вночі він ледь світиться, шукай між надгробками.
I need grave dust for a warding charm. Gather six handfuls from the old graveyard. It glows faintly at night, look between the tombstones.
dw_dust_done_uk: Добре, добре. Тепер можна зробити оберіг.
Good, good. Now the charm can be made.
dw_charm_offer_uk: Віднеси цей оберіг Едвінові, доглядачеві цвинтаря. Він захистить його від прокляття, поки той спить.
Take this charm to Edwin, the gravekeeper. It will protect him from the curse while he sleeps.
edwin_hello_uk: Сорок років я доглядаю ці могили, і жодного разу мерці не ходили. Аж дотепер.
I have kept these graves for forty years, and never have the dead walked. Until now.
edwin_wait_uk: Мерці не спочивають, і нам не можна.
The dead do not rest, and neither should we.
dw_bones_offer_uk: Скелети носять прокляті кістки, що змушують їх ходити. Розбий їх і принеси мені вісім проклятих кісток, щоб я їх спалив.
The skeletons carry cursed bones that keep them walking. Break them and bring me eight cursed bones so I can burn them.
dw_bones_done_uk: У вогонь їх. Хай нарешті спочинуть.
Into the fire they go. May they finally rest.
dw_charm_done_uk: Оберіг від Мари? Хай благословить ту стару відьму. Сьогодні я спатиму спокійно.
A charm from Mara? Bless that old witch. I will sleep soundly tonight.
dw_lord_offer_uk: У склепі щось прокинулося. Володар Могил. Він піднімає мерців і кличе вогонь із неба. Покінчи з ним, і Темноліс знову засне.
Something woke inside the crypt. The Grave Lord. He raises the dead and calls fire from the sky. End him, and Darkwood will sleep again.
dw_lord_done_uk: Володар Могил упав. Я знову чую птахів. Дякую, героє. Щасливої дороги до Золотих Полів.
The Grave Lord has fallen. I can hear the birds again. Thank you, hero. Travel safely to the farmlands.
haldor_hello_uk: Мене звати Гальдор. Ця ферма належить моїй родині вже шість поколінь, і я не віддам її гнолам.
Haldor's the name. This farm has been in my family for six generations, and I'm not losing it to gnolls.
haldor_wait_uk: Well? The gnolls aren't going to leave on their own.
gf_gears_offer_uk: Ці жнивні големи колись обробляли мої поля. Тепер щось звело їх із розуму. Розбий їх і принеси мені п'ять шестерень, щоб я з'ясував, що сталося.
Those harvest golems used to work my fields. Now something has driven them mad. Smash them and bring me five golem gears so I can figure out what happened.
gf_gears_done_uk: Хм. На цих шестернях магія гнолів. Я так і знав.
Hmm. Gnoll magic on these gears. I knew it.
gf_flour_done_uk: Борошно від Міллі! Перекажи їй, що вона пече найкращий хліб у долині.
Flour from Millie! Tell her she makes the best bread in the valley.
millie_hello_uk: Привіт! Я Міллі, тримаю вітряк. Ну, тримала, доки не прийшли гноли.
Hi there! I'm Millie, I run the windmill. Well, I did, before the gnolls came.
millie_wait_uk: Ще шукаєш? Нічого, не поспішай. Хоча ні, будь ласка, поспіши.
Still looking? It's okay, take your time. Actually, please hurry.
gf_wheat_offer_uk: Гноли розкидали врожай по всіх полях. Збереш мені вісім снопів пшениці? Тоді я змелю їх на борошно.
The gnolls scattered the harvest all over the fields. Can you gather eight wheat sheaves for me? Then I can grind them into flour.
gf_wheat_done_uk: Perfect! The mill can turn again.
gf_flour_offer_uk: Ось, віднеси цей мішок борошна фермерові Гальдору в хату. Він буркотливий, але насправді добрий, коли його пізнаєш.
Here, take this sack of flour to Farmer Haldor at the farmhouse. He's grumpy, but he's sweet once you know him.
ostrand_hello_uk: Капітан Остранд, королівська варта. Гноли зібралися у воєнному таборі на північному заході.
Captain Ostrand, of the kingdom's watch. The gnolls have gathered in a war camp to the north west.
ostrand_wait_uk: Report back when the job is done.
gf_gnolls_offer_uk: Їхні грабіжники всюди. Вбий десятьох гнолів-грабіжників і зламай їхній дух.
Their raiders are everywhere. Kill ten gnoll raiders and break their spirit.
gf_gnolls_done_uk: Десять грабіжників. У їхньому таборі безлад. Добре.
Ten raiders. Their camp is in disarray. Good.
gf_shamans_offer_uk: Їхні шамани лікують поранених. Спершу вбий чотирьох шаманів, і решта впаде легше.
Their shamans heal the wounded. Kill four gnoll shamans first and the rest will fall easier.
gf_shamans_done_uk: Без цілителів вони просто злі пси.
Without healers, they're just angry dogs.
gf_warlord_offer_uk: Їхній ватажок, демон на ім'я Геш, командує воєнним табором. Вбий його, і повстанню кінець.
Their leader is a demon called Gash. He commands the war camp. Kill him and the uprising ends.
gf_warlord_done_uk: Геш мертвий! Поля вільні. Кажуть, на гірському перевалі на півночі теж біда.
Gash is dead! The farmlands are free. They say the mountain pass to the north is in trouble too.
thorgrim_hello_uk: Брр! Ласкаво просимо на перевал Морозний Пік. Я Торгрім. Остерігайся єті.
Brr! Welcome to Frostpeak Pass, lad. Name's Thorgrim. Mind the yetis.
thorgrim_wait_uk: Гора нікого не чекає. До справи.
The mountain waits for no one. Get to it.
fp_wolves_offer_uk: Снігові вовки полюють тут зграями. Вони жеруть моїх в'ючних мулів. Вбий вісьмох.
Snow wolves hunt in packs up here. They've been eating my supply mules. Kill eight of them.
fp_wolves_done_uk: Ха! Це їх провчить. Мої мули тобі вдячні.
Ha! That'll teach them. My mules thank you.
fp_trolls_offer_uk: З вершин спустилися крижані тролі. Великі, бридкі і гатять об землю. Вбий шістьох.
Ice trolls have come down from the peaks. Big, ugly and they slam the ground. Kill six.
fp_trolls_done_uk: Шість тролів! Ти міцніший, ніж здаєшся.
Six trolls! You're tougher than you look.
fp_frostmaw_offer_uk: У крижаних печерах на півночі живе старий звір. Морозна Паща. Найбільший єті, якого будь-хто бачив. Убий його, і перевал стане безпечним.
There's an old beast in the ice caves to the north. Frostmaw. Biggest yeti anyone has ever seen. Slay it and the pass is safe.
fp_frostmaw_done_uk: Морозна Паща мертва! Про це співатимуть у кожній корчмі. Рушай на південь, до каньйону, коли будеш готовий.
Frostmaw, dead! They'll sing songs about this in every tavern. Head south to the canyon when you're ready.
sila_hello_uk: Говори тихіше. У єті гострий слух. Я Сіла, рейнджерка перевалу.
Keep your voice down. Yetis have sharp ears. I'm Sila, ranger of the pass.
sila_wait_uk: The cold is getting worse. Hurry.
fp_fur_offer_uk: Мені потрібне хутро єті, щоб пошити плащі для застави. Принеси шість шкур морозних єті.
I need yeti fur to make cloaks for the outpost. Bring me six pelts from the frost yetis.
fp_fur_done_uk: Теплі плащі для всіх. Сьогодні вночі ніхто не замерзне.
Warm cloaks for everyone. Nobody will freeze tonight.
fp_lotus_offer_uk: Біля замерзлого озера росте морозний лотос. Він світиться синім. Збери шість, і я зварю зілля від холоду.
Frost lotus grows near the frozen lake. It glows blue. Gather six, I can brew a potion against the cold.
fp_lotus_done_uk: Beautiful. This will keep the frostbite away.
fp_supplies_offer_uk: Віднеси ці припаси Торгрімові на заставу. Він знатиме, що з ними робити.
Take these supplies back to Thorgrim at the outpost. He'll know what to do with them.
fp_supplies_done_uk: Припаси від Сіли? Хай їй щастить. Тепер ми втримаємо заставу.
Supplies from Sila? Bless her. Now we can hold the outpost.
kaelen_hello_uk: Тримайся в межах охоронного кола! Жар там може розплавити сталь. Я Каелен, архімаг Жаркої Кузні.
Stay inside the ward circle! The heat out there could melt steel. I am Kaelen, archmage of the Emberforge.
kaelen_wait_uk: Вогонь шириться з кожною годиною. Будь ласка, поспіши.
The fire spreads with every hour. Please hurry.
ec_hounds_offer_uk: Дном каньйону блукають пекельні пси. Їхній укус пече. Вбий вісьмох.
Hellhounds roam the canyon floor. Their bite burns. Kill eight of them.
ec_hounds_done_uk: The hounds are thinning. Well done.
ec_crystals_offer_uk: Навколо лавових озер виросли вогняні кристали. Мені треба шість, щоб підзарядити охоронне коло. Збери їх, але не ступай у лаву.
Fire crystals have grown around the lava pools. I need six to recharge the ward. Gather them, but do not step in the lava.
ec_crystals_done_uk: Excellent! The ward will hold a while longer.
ec_pyrax_offer_uk: Джерело цього пекла, демон-володар на ім'я Піракс. Він чекає в серці каньйону. Знищ його.
The source of this inferno is a demon lord named Pyrax. He waits at the heart of the canyon. Destroy him.
ec_pyrax_done_uk: Піракса вигнано! Вогні вже згасають. Лишилася одна земля, Затонуле Узбережжя.
Pyrax is banished! The fires are already dying down. One land remains, the sunken coast.
ryla_hello_uk: Пст! Сюди! Розвідниця Райла. Я вже кілька днів стежу за культистами.
Psst! Over here! Scout Ryla. I've been watching the cultists for days.
ryla_wait_uk: Ще там? Вони готують щось велике.
Still out there? They're getting ready for something big.
ec_horns_offer_uk: Вогняні біси носять роги, повні магії. Принеси мені шість рогів, і я з'ясую, що замислили культисти.
The fire imps carry horns full of magic. Bring me six imp horns and I can figure out what the cultists are planning.
ec_horns_done_uk: Ці роги аж гудуть від сили. Вони когось викликають!
These horns are humming with power. They're summoning something!
ec_cultists_offer_uk: Вогняні культисти проводять ритуал. Вбий шістьох і зірви його.
The flame cultists are holding the ritual. Kill six of them and disrupt it.
ec_cultists_done_uk: The ritual is broken. Nice work!
ec_report_offer_uk: Віднеси мій звіт архімагові Каелену. Він має знати, що ми знайшли.
Take my report to Archmage Kaelen. He needs to know what we found.
ec_report_done_uk: Ритуал виклику? Тоді Піракс уже тут. Дякую, друже розвідниці.
A summoning ritual? Then Pyrax is already here. Thank you, scout's friend.
ec_raptors_offer_uk: Раптори полюють у цьому каньйоні зграями, швидкі, як стріли. Вони забрали двох моїх розвідників. Знищ шістьох, поки вони не забрали ще когось.
Raptors hunt this canyon in packs, fast as arrows. They took two of my scouts. Cull six of them before they take more.
ec_raptors_done_uk: Шість рапторів... і всі сліди укусів ведуть до одного гнізда на сході. Ними керує щось значно більше.
Six raptors... and every bite mark points back to one nest in the east. Something much bigger leads them.
ec_tyrant_offer_uk: На схід від каньйону лежить гніздо з кісток. Там спить Тиран Каньйону - мати всіх тутешніх рапторів. Убий його, і зграї розбіжаться.
East of the canyon lies a nest of bones. The Canyon Tyrant sleeps there - the mother of every raptor here. Kill it, and the packs will scatter.
ec_tyrant_done_uk: Тиран мертвий? Я відчула, як земля перестала тремтіти. Каньйон знову наш - дякую.
The Tyrant is dead? I felt the ground stop shaking. The canyon is ours again - thank you.
gale_hello_uk: Агов. Старий Гейл. П'ятдесят років я рибалю на цьому узбережжі, і ніколи такого не бачив.
Ahoy there. Old Gale. I've fished this coast for fifty years, and I've never seen it like this.
gale_wait_uk: Море не чекатиме, і ці чудовиська теж.
The sea won't wait, and neither will those monsters.

in_4: The forest was strangely quiet. No birds. No shelling. Only that light between the trees.

in_5: Mushrooms. Glowing like a phone screen at night. I was hungry... and stupid.
in_5_uk: Гриби. Світяться, як екран телефону вночі. Я був голодний... і дурний.
Mushrooms. Glowing like a phone screen at night. I was hungry... and stupid.
in_6: The ground tilted. The sky folded like paper. And then... nothing.

in_7: When I opened my eyes, the war was gone. But my rifle was still in my hands.

en_1: Ти переміг Капітана Кісток. Тепер я можу розповісти тобі правду. Я теж не звідси.
You beat Captain Bones. Now I can tell you the truth. I'm not from here either.
en_2: Колись я був фермером. Орав поле на старому тракторі, а у вільний час літав на дронах.
I used to be a farmer. I ploughed the field on an old tractor, and in my spare time I flew drones.
en_3: Одного вечора біля річки я побачив русалку. Справжню. Вона виринула біля каменя й усміхнулася.
One evening by the river I saw a mermaid. A real one. She rose out of the water by a rock and smiled.
en_4: Вона простягла мені гриб, що світився, а натомість попросила мій пульт від дрона. Я погодився. Навіщо, сам не знаю.
She held out a glowing mushroom, and in return she asked for my drone controller. I agreed. I still don't know why.
en_5: Я з'їв його і прокинувся тут. Багато років тому. Я вчив їхню магію, а дрони збирав з того, що знаходив.
I ate it and woke up here. Many years ago. I learned their magic and built drones from whatever I could find.
en_6: Коли я побачив твій автомат, я одразу все зрозумів. Ти з дому. З нашого дому.
When I saw your rifle, I understood everything at once. You're from home. Our home.
en_7: За маяком росте той самий гриб. Він може повернути тебе назад. Вирішуй сам: залишитись чи йти додому.
