shop_hello_f: Good day! Take your time and look around.
shop_hello_f_uk: Good day! Take your time and look around.
jq_summons_offer: A royal rider came while you were away. King Aldemar himself asks to see the stranger with the thunder weapon. Kingsreach lies in Goldfield, through VesPer's portal.
jq_summons_offer_uk: Поки тебе не було, прибув королівський гонець. Сам король Алдемар хоче бачити чужинця з громовою зброєю. Кінгсріч лежить у Золотих Полях, за порталом ВесПера.
A royal rider came while you were away. King Aldemar himself asks to see the stranger with the thunder weapon. Kingsreach lies in Goldfield, through VesPer's portal.
jq_summons_s0: So you are the one. A weapon that roars like thunder, and a man who fell from another sky. Kneel later. First, I need your help.
jq_summons_s0_uk: Отже, це ти. Зброя, що гуркоче, як грім, і людина, що впала з іншого неба. Вклонишся згодом. Спершу мені потрібна твоя допомога.
So you are the one. A weapon that roars like thunder, and a man who fell from another sky. Kneel later. First, I need your help.
jq_blight_offer: The Grey Blight spreads from Darkwood. The Mayor of Ravenmoor sends me nothing but bad news. Go to him, and find out what wakes the dead.
jq_blight_offer_uk: Сіра Пошесть повзе з Темнолісу. Мер Рейвенмура шле мені лише погані новини. Іди до нього й дізнайся, що будить мерців.
The Grey Blight spreads from Darkwood. The Mayor of Ravenmoor sends me nothing but bad news. Go to him, and find out what wakes the dead.
jq_blight_s0: The King sent you? Good. A creature walks at the Ritual Stones, the Blight Herald. Wherever it goes, the dead rise. Kill it.
jq_blight_s0_uk: Тебе послав король? Добре. Біля Ритуальних каменів бродить істота, Вісник Пошесті. Куди він іде, там встають мерці. Убий його.
The King sent you? Good. A creature walks at the Ritual Stones, the Blight Herald. Wherever it goes, the dead rise. Kill it.
jq_blight_s2: The Herald is dead? Then there is hope. You have the gratitude of the crown.
jq_blight_s2_uk: Вісник мертвий? Тоді ще є надія. Корона тобі вдячна.
The Herald is dead? Then there is hope. You have the gratitude of the crown.
jq_stariron_offer: My guards have learned to make your fire sticks, but our iron cracks. The dwarf Thorgrim in Frostpeak speaks of star iron. Bring me some.
jq_stariron_offer_uk: Мої вартові навчилися робити твої вогняні палиці, але наше залізо тріскається. Гном Торгрім із Морозного Піку говорить про зоряне залізо. Принеси мені трохи.
My guards have learned to make your fire sticks, but our iron cracks. The dwarf Thorgrim in Frostpeak speaks of star iron. Bring me some.
jq_stariron_s0: Star iron, eh? It falls from the sky and the trolls hoard it. Break silver veins, hunt trolls and yetis, and you'll find it. Five pieces should do.
jq_stariron_s0_uk: Зоряне залізо, кажеш? Воно падає з неба, а тролі його збирають. Розбивай срібні жили, полюй на тролів і єті, і знайдеш. П'яти шматків вистачить.
Star iron, eh? It falls from the sky and the trolls hoard it. Break silver veins, hunt trolls and yetis, and you'll find it. Five pieces should do.
jq_stariron_s1: Star iron! Our smiths will forge barrels that never crack. Every musket in the realm will carry your name.
jq_stariron_s1_uk: Зоряне залізо! Наші ковалі викують стволи, що ніколи не тріснуть. Кожен мушкет у королівстві носитиме твоє ім'я.
Star iron! Our smiths will forge barrels that never crack. Every musket in the realm will carry your name.
jq_envoy_offer: Lady Elsbeth, my envoy, must reach the fire mages of Emberforge. Escort her safely to the portal. Monsters can smell her silk a mile away.
jq_envoy_offer_uk: Леді Ельсбет, моя посланниця, мусить дістатися до вогняних магів Жаркої Кузні. Проведи її до порталу. Чудовиська чують її шовк за милю.
Lady Elsbeth, my envoy, must reach the fire mages of Emberforge. Escort her safely to the portal. Monsters can smell her silk a mile away.
jq_envoy_s1: The King's envoy arrived safely, thanks to you. But the Ash Tyrant blocks our roads. Destroy it, and Emberforge will stand with the crown.
jq_envoy_s1_uk: Королівська посланниця прибула ціла, завдяки тобі. Але Попелястий Тиран перекриває наші дороги. Знищ його, і Жарка Кузня стане на бік корони.
The King's envoy arrived safely, thanks to you. But the Ash Tyrant blocks our roads. Destroy it, and Emberforge will stand with the crown.
jq_envoy_s3: Emberforge stands with us. You have done what my knights could not.
jq_envoy_s3_uk: Жарка Кузня з нами. Ти зробив те, що не змогли мої лицарі.
Emberforge stands with us. You have done what my knights could not.
jq_crown_offer: One last thing. My father's crown sank off the Sunken Coast. The Harbourmaster of Saltmere knows those waters. Bring it home.
jq_crown_offer_uk: Ще одне. Корона мого батька потонула біля Затонулого Узбережжя. Начальник порту Солтміра знає ті води. Поверни її додому.
One last thing. My father's crown sank off the Sunken Coast. The Harbourmaster of Saltmere knows those waters. Bring it home.
jq_crown_s0: The old king's crown? The sea witches keep it as a trinket. They trade for abyssal pearls. Bring me three, and I'll strike the deal.
jq_crown_s0_uk: Корона старого короля? Морські відьми тримають її як прикрасу. Вони міняються на безодні перли. Принеси три, і я домовлюся.
The old king's crown? The sea witches keep it as a trinket. They trade for abyssal pearls. Bring me three, and I'll strike the deal.
jq_crown_s1: Three pearls. Done. Here, wrapped in sailcloth. Take it to the King before anyone gets ideas.
jq_crown_s1_uk: Три перлини. Готово. Ось, загорнута у вітрило. Неси її королю, поки нікому не спало на думку.
Three pearls. Done. Here, wrapped in sailcloth. Take it to the King before anyone gets ideas.
jq_crown_s2: My father's crown. You are more than a stranger now. You are a friend of this kingdom, forever.
jq_crown_s2_uk: Корона мого батька. Тепер ти більше, ніж чужинець. Ти друг цього королівства, навіки.
My father's crown. You are more than a stranger now. You are a friend of this kingdom, forever.
jq_letters_offer: This letter must reach Mayor Corvin in Ravenmoor, sealed and unread. The roads are dangerous, so the pay is good.
jq_letters_offer_uk: Цей лист має дійти до мера Корвіна в Рейвенмурі, запечатаний і непрочитаний. Дороги небезпечні, тож платня добра.
This letter must reach Mayor Corvin in Ravenmoor, sealed and unread. The roads are dangerous, so the pay is good.
jq_letters_s0: A royal letter. Finally, someone remembers Ravenmoor. Thank you, courier.
jq_letters_s0_uk: Королівський лист. Нарешті хтось згадав про Рейвенмур. Дякую, кур'єре.
A royal letter. Finally, someone remembers Ravenmoor. Thank you, courier.
jq_salt_offer: The capital's kitchens have run out of salt. Carry this barrel to Postmaster Pell in Kingsreach, would you?
jq_salt_offer_uk: На кухнях столиці скінчилася сіль. Віднесеш цю діжку поштмейстеру Пеллу в Кінгсріч?
The capital's kitchens have run out of salt. Carry this barrel to Postmaster Pell in Kingsreach, would you?
jq_salt_s0: Salt from Saltmere! The royal cooks will kiss you. Well, maybe not.
jq_salt_s0_uk: Сіль із Солтміра! Королівські кухарі тебе розцілують. Ну, може й ні.
Salt from Saltmere! The royal cooks will kiss you. Well, maybe not.
jq_grain_offer: The King's kitchen buys our grain now. Could you take a sack to the Royal Post in Kingsreach? Farmers don't travel by portal.
jq_grain_offer_uk: Королівська кухня тепер купує наше зерно. Віднесеш мішок на королівську пошту в Кінгсріч? Фермери порталом не подорожують.
The King's kitchen buys our grain now. Could you take a sack to the Royal Post in Kingsreach? Farmers don't travel by portal.
jq_grain_s0: Northvale grain, the best bread in the realm. Thank you.
jq_grain_s0_uk: Нортвейлське зерно, найкращий хліб у королівстві. Дякую.
Northvale grain, the best bread in the realm. Thank you.
jq_pilgrim_offer: Brother Tomas went to pray at the old camp in the west and never came back. If he still lives, bring him to the portal at Hollowmere.
jq_pilgrim_offer_uk: Брат Томас пішов молитися до старого табору на заході й не повернувся. Якщо він живий, приведи його до порталу в Голловмірі.
Brother Tomas went to pray at the old camp in the west and never came back. If he still lives, bring him to the portal at Hollowmere.
jq_pilgrim_s1: Tomas is safe? Ravenmoor owes you. Here, take this.
jq_pilgrim_s1_uk: Томас у безпеці? Рейвенмур у боргу перед тобою. Ось, візьми.
Tomas is safe? Ravenmoor owes you. Here, take this.
jq_lotus_offer: I need frost lotus for the King's medicine. It only grows in Frostpeak. Four blossoms, please, and I'll pay you in potions.
jq_lotus_offer_uk: Мені потрібен морозний лотос для ліків короля. Він росте лише на Морозному Піку. Чотири квітки, будь ласка, і я заплачу зіллям.
I need frost lotus for the King's medicine. It only grows in Frostpeak. Four blossoms, please, and I'll pay you in potions.
jq_lotus_s0: Perfect blossoms, still cold. The King will sleep tonight. Here are your potions.
jq_lotus_s0_uk: Чудові квіти, ще холодні. Король сьогодні засне. Ось твоє зілля.
Perfect blossoms, still cold. The King will sleep tonight. Here are your potions.
jq_cores_offer: Ember cores from Emberforge burn hotter than any coal. Bring me three, and I'll forge you something worth carrying.
jq_cores_offer_uk: Жарові ядра з Жаркої Кузні горять гарячіше за будь-яке вугілля. Принеси три, і я викую тобі щось варте.
Ember cores from Emberforge burn hotter than any coal. Bring me three, and I'll forge you something worth carrying.
jq_cores_s0: Feel that heat! Give me a moment. There. Finest work I've ever done.
jq_cores_s0_uk: Відчуй цей жар! Дай мені хвильку. Ось. Найкраща робота, яку я колись робила.
Feel that heat! Give me a moment. There. Finest work I've ever done.
jq_dust_offer: Blight dust from Darkwood could help me understand the curse. Five handfuls. The ghouls carry it.
jq_dust_offer_uk: Пил Пошесті з Темнолісу допоміг би мені зрозуміти прокляття. П'ять жмень. Його носять упирі.
Blight dust from Darkwood could help me understand the curse. Five handfuls. The ghouls carry it.
jq_dust_s0: This dust... it smells of the grave, and of something older. Thank you. Take these, they will help you.
jq_dust_s0_uk: Цей пил... він пахне могилою і чимось давнішим. Дякую. Візьми це, воно тобі допоможе.
This dust... it smells of the grave, and of something older. Thank you. Take these, they will help you.
brannock_hello2: Still in one piece. Good. Report.
brannock_hello2_uk: Still in one piece. Good. Report.
brannock_targets_wait: The targets are in the yard behind the post. Five of them. Take your time, and hit only what you aim at.
brannock_targets_wait_uk: Мішені у дворі за постом. П'ять штук. Не поспішай і влучай тільки в те, у що цілишся.
The targets are in the yard behind the post. Five of them. Take your time, and hit only what you aim at.
brannock_town: Too many roads, too few guards, and not enough food to keep everyone calm. A captain in a proper army would call this a supply problem. Here, it's Tuesday.
brannock_town_uk: Забагато доріг, замало вартових і не вистачає їжі, щоб усі були спокійні. Капітан справжньої армії назвав би це проблемою постачання. А в нас це звичайний вівторок.
Too many roads, too few guards, and not enough food to keep everyone calm. A captain in a proper army would call this a supply problem. Here, it's Tuesday.
brannock_weapon: I'm not asking you to teach every farmer to shoot that thing. I'm asking you to tell me how to keep a village alive when something like it is pointed at us.
brannock_weapon_uk: Я не прошу вчити кожного фермера стріляти з цієї штуки. Я прошу сказати, як вберегти село, коли щось подібне наведуть на нас.
I'm not asking you to teach every farmer to shoot that thing. I'm asking you to tell me how to keep a village alive when something like it is pointed at us.
brannock_bandits: Their captain was never clever. He was patient. He waited until everyone was afraid of the forest, then he robbed the people who were too frightened to look outside.
brannock_bandits_uk: Їхній ватажок ніколи не був розумним. Він був терплячим. Чекав, поки всі почнуть боятися лісу, а тоді грабував тих, хто боявся навіть визирнути надвір.
Their captain was never clever. He was patient. He waited until everyone was afraid of the forest, then he robbed the people who were too frightened to look outside.
brannock_shield: Pavlo's. He walked the mine road at dusk and never walked back. I keep it so I don't forget whose turn it was.
brannock_shield_uk: Це щит Павла. Він пішов шахтарською дорогою надвечір і не повернувся. Я тримаю щит, щоб не забути, чия тоді була черга.
Pavlo's. He walked the mine road at dusk and never walked back. I keep it so I don't forget whose turn it was.
brannock_after_captain: You handled yourself well. Don't let it go to your head. Tomorrow there will be another problem, and it will probably be worse.
brannock_after_captain_uk: Ти добре впорався. Тільки не зазнавайся. Завтра буде нова проблема, і, мабуть, гірша.
You handled yourself well. Don't let it go to your head. Tomorrow there will be another problem, and it will probably be worse.
brannock_recruits_1: You move like someone who was taught, not someone who learned by bleeding. How do they train recruits where you come from?
brannock_recruits_1_uk: Ти рухаєшся як той, кого навчили, а не як той, хто вчився, стікаючи кров'ю. Як у вас там навчають новобранців?
You move like someone who was taught, not someone who learned by bleeding. How do they train recruits where you come from?
brannock_recruits_fire: Aimed, and never wasted. My archers could stand to hear that. Twice.
brannock_recruits_fire_uk: Прицільно і ніколи марно. Моїм лучникам варто це почути. Двічі.
Aimed, and never wasted. My archers could stand to hear that. Twice.
brannock_recruits_team: Everyone covers someone. I'll have that carved over the guard post door.
brannock_recruits_team_uk: Кожен прикриває когось. Накажу вирізати це над дверима посту.
Everyone covers someone. I'll have that carved over the guard post door.
brannock_recruits_dig: A ditch. You want my lads to dig ditches. ...Fine. Maybell has spades.
brannock_recruits_dig_uk: Рів. Ти хочеш, щоб мої хлопці копали рови. ...Гаразд. У Мейбел є лопати.
A ditch. You want my lads to dig ditches. ...Fine. Maybell has spades.
brannock_meet_1: Hold there. Put that thing down.
brannock_meet_1_uk: Hold there. Put that thing down.
brannock_meet_trouble: Nobody ever is. Trouble finds them anyway, usually carrying something like that.
brannock_meet_trouble_uk: Ніхто ніколи не шукає. А біда все одно знаходить, і зазвичай з чимось таким у руках.
Nobody ever is. Trouble finds them anyway, usually carrying something like that.
brannock_meet_where: Northvale. Unless you fell from the moon, in which case I'm afraid our moon has no road signs.
brannock_meet_where_uk: Нортвейл. Хіба що ти впав з місяця, але, боюся, на нашому місяці немає дорожніх знаків.
Northvale. Unless you fell from the moon, in which case I'm afraid our moon has no road signs.
brannock_meet_year: The year the bells rang on their own, if you ask anyone here. Before that it was the year of the late frost. We count by trouble.
brannock_meet_year_uk: Рік, коли дзвони задзвонили самі, якщо спитаєш будь-кого тут. До того був рік пізніх заморозків. Ми рахуємо роки бідами.
The year the bells rang on their own, if you ask anyone here. Before that it was the year of the late frost. We count by trouble.
brannock_meet_rifle: I have seen siege engines. I have seen crossbows that punch through shields. That thing is neither. Tell me how it works.
brannock_meet_rifle_uk: Я бачив облогові машини. Бачив арбалети, що пробивають щити. Ця штука ні те, ні інше. Розкажи, як вона працює.
I have seen siege engines. I have seen crossbows that punch through shields. That thing is neither. Tell me how it works.
brannock_meet_explain: That's all, he says. Fine. And when the pieces run out?
brannock_meet_explain_uk: «Тільки й усього», каже він. Гаразд. А коли шматочки закінчаться?
That's all, he says. Fine. And when the pieces run out?
brannock_meet_limit: Honest, at least. Most men with a new weapon swear it will win the war by itself.
brannock_meet_limit_uk: Принаймні чесно. Більшість людей з новою зброєю клянуться, що вона сама виграє війну.
Honest, at least. Most men with a new weapon swear it will win the war by itself.
brannock_meet_soldier: Every soldier. Then I hope your army is far from here, and stays there.
brannock_meet_soldier_uk: Кожен солдат. Тоді сподіваюся, що твоя армія далеко звідси і там і залишиться.
Every soldier. Then I hope your army is far from here, and stays there.
brannock_meet_test: Here's how this goes. You stay in Northvale under my eye. In the yard behind the post there are five targets. Show me you can hit what you aim at, and only what you aim at.
brannock_meet_test_uk: Ось як усе буде. Ти залишаєшся в Нортвейлі під моїм наглядом. У дворі за постом стоять п'ять мішеней. Покажи, що влучаєш у те, у що цілишся, і тільки в це.
Here's how this goes. You stay in Northvale under my eye. In the yard behind the post there are five targets. Show me you can hit what you aim at, and only what you aim at.
stranger_done_1: Five for five. And you didn't flinch at the noise, which is more than I can say for my men.
stranger_done_1_uk: П'ять із п'яти. І ти навіть не здригнувся від гуркоту, чого не скажеш про моїх хлопців.
Five for five. And you didn't flinch at the noise, which is more than I can say for my men.
stranger_done_2: You can walk the village. Folk will stare, and some will cross the road when they see you. Let them. Take these: bandages, and a pouch a pedlar sold us as thunder seeds. I think they're yours. Then go and see Brother Aldric at the church, and Maybell at the farm. They need hands.
stranger_done_2_uk: Можеш ходити селом. Люди витріщатимуться, а дехто переходитиме на інший бік дороги. Хай. Візьми ось це: бинти і торбинку, яку нам продав коробейник як «громове насіння». Гадаю, це твоє. А тоді йди до брата Алдріка в церкву і до Мейбел на ферму. Їм потрібні руки.

You can walk the village. Folk will stare, and some will cross the road when they see you. Let them. Take these: bandages, and a pouch a pedlar sold us as thunder seeds. I think they're yours. Then go and see Brother Aldric at the church, and Maybell at the farm. They need hands.
brannock_bandana_guards: I could send the three men I have. Then the village gate is empty, the farm is undefended, and you can explain to Maybell why her chickens have become bandit property.
brannock_bandana_guards_uk: Я міг би послати тих трьох, що в мене є. Тоді ворота села порожні, ферма без захисту, а ти пояснюватимеш Мейбел, чому її кури стали власністю бандитів.
I could send the three men I have. Then the village gate is empty, the farm is undefended, and you can explain to Maybell why her chickens have become bandit property.
brannock_bandana_go: Good. Their camp is south-east, past the Old Oak road. Mind the lookouts.
brannock_bandana_go_uk: Добре. Їхній табір на південному сході, за дорогою до Старого Дуба. Стережися дозорців.
Good. Their camp is south-east, past the Old Oak road. Mind the lookouts.
brannock_bandana_done_2: Somebody is paying them in more than bread. I want to know who.
brannock_bandana_done_2_uk: Хтось платить їм не лише хлібом. Я хочу знати хто.
Somebody is paying them in more than bread. I want to know who.
nv_missing_offer: Stepan didn't come back from the mine road last night. He's young, he's stubborn, and he's mine. Find him. If he's dead, bring me his patrol badge, so his mother has something to bury.
nv_missing_offer_uk: Степан не повернувся вчора з шахтарської дороги. Він молодий, упертий і він мій. Знайди його. Якщо він мертвий, принеси мені його знак патруля, щоб його матері було що поховати.
Stepan didn't come back from the mine road last night. He's young, he's stubborn, and he's mine. Find him. If he's dead, bring me his patrol badge, so his mother has something to bury.
brannock_missing_go: Take the west track past the sawmill. There's an old shelter where the road bends. Start there.
brannock_missing_go_uk: Іди західною стежкою повз лісопилку. Там, де дорога повертає, є стара хатина. Почни звідти.
Take the west track past the sawmill. There's an old shelter where the road bends. Start there.
nv_missing_done: Stepan's back, limping and grinning like a fool. With his badge. So. What did he see out there?
nv_missing_done_uk: Степан повернувся, кульгає і шкіриться, як дурень. І знак при ньому. Ну. Що він там бачив?
Stepan's back, limping and grinning like a fool. With his badge. So. What did he see out there?
brannock_missing_why: Why would bandits care about a church box?
brannock_missing_why_uk: Why would bandits care about a church box?
brannock_missing_full: Then the captain is not just a thief. Thank you for the whole truth. I'll remember it.
brannock_missing_full_uk: Отже, ватажок не просто злодій. Дякую, що сказав усю правду. Я це запам'ятаю.
Then the captain is not just a thief. Thank you for the whole truth. I'll remember it.
brannock_missing_partial: Stolen goods. Of course. That's what they do best.
brannock_missing_partial_uk: Крадене добро. Звісно. Це в них найкраще виходить.
Stolen goods. Of course. That's what they do best.
nv_ledger_offer: That captain keeps accounts. Thieves who can write always do. Get into the camp and bring me his ledger. Quietly, if you can manage quiet with that thing.
nv_ledger_offer_uk: Цей ватажок веде облік. Злодії, які вміють писати, завжди ведуть. Проберися в табір і принеси мені його книгу. Тихо, якщо з цією штукою взагалі можна тихо.
That captain keeps accounts. Thieves who can write always do. Get into the camp and bring me his ledger. Quietly, if you can manage quiet with that thing.
brannock_ledger_go: His tent is the one with red cloth for a roof. Of course it is.
brannock_ledger_go_uk: Його намет той, що з червоним полотном замість даху. Ну звісно.
His tent is the one with red cloth for a roof. Of course it is.
nv_ledger_done: Food. Batteries, whatever those are. Iron tools. And this: one sealed box from the church. Payment received from a traveller. Do not break the seal.
nv_ledger_done_uk: Їжа. Батареї, хоч би що це було. Залізні інструменти. І ось: одна запечатана скринька з церкви. Плату отримано від мандрівника. Печатку не ламати.
Food. Batteries, whatever those are. Iron tools. And this: one sealed box from the church. Payment received from a traveller. Do not break the seal.
brannock_ledger_2: Dated before you came. A traveller. In a valley where nobody travels unless they're lost, desperate, or dead.
brannock_ledger_2_uk: Записано ще до твого приходу. Мандрівник. У долині, куди ніхто не мандрує, хіба що заблукалі, зневірені або мертві.
Dated before you came. A traveller. In a valley where nobody travels unless they're lost, desperate, or dead.
brannock_ledger_vesper: The boy with the flying toy? He can't haggle for a loaf of bread without apologising. But I've been wrong before.
brannock_ledger_vesper_uk: Хлопець з літаючою іграшкою? Він не може поторгуватися за хлібину, не перепросивши. Але я вже помилявся.
The boy with the flying toy? He can't haggle for a loaf of bread without apologising. But I've been wrong before.
brannock_ledger_withheld: A box from the church. Stepan told me about it after you'd gone. You didn't. I don't know why, and I won't ask today.
brannock_ledger_withheld_uk: Скринька з церкви. Степан розповів мені про неї, коли ти пішов. А ти не розповів. Не знаю чому, і сьогодні не питатиму.
A box from the church. Stepan told me about it after you'd gone. You didn't. I don't know why, and I won't ask today.
brannock_ledger_end: Only the captain knows who paid him. Time we asked him. Here, Stepan's key. It opens the back gate of their camp.
brannock_ledger_end_uk: Тільки ватажок знає, хто йому заплатив. Час його спитати. Ось ключ Степана, він відмикає задню хвіртку їхнього табору.
Only the captain knows who paid him. Time we asked him. Here, Stepan's key. It opens the back gate of their camp.
brannock_captain_fragment: Dark metal. Cold as a well bucket in winter. Show Aldric. Then put it somewhere far from my men.
brannock_captain_fragment_uk: Темний метал. Холодний, як відро з криниці взимку. Покажи Алдрікові. А тоді сховай подалі від моїх людей.
Dark metal. Cold as a well bucket in winter. Show Aldric. Then put it somewhere far from my men.
brannock_captain_end: Go and see Aldric. He'll want to look at the east road before anyone else does.
brannock_captain_end_uk: Іди до Алдріка. Він захоче глянути на східну дорогу раніше за всіх.
Go and see Aldric. He'll want to look at the east road before anyone else does.
brannock_road: Then we stop pretending the road will fix itself.
brannock_road_uk: Тоді годі вдавати, що дорога полагодиться сама.
Then we stop pretending the road will fix itself.
stepan_1: You're the stranger with the thunder stick. Brannock sent you? Thank the saints. I thought those little devils would wait me out.
stepan_1_uk: Ти той чужинець з громовою палицею. Тебе послав Бранок? Слава святим. Я вже думав, ці чортенята мене пересидять.
You're the stranger with the thunder stick. Brannock sent you? Thank the saints. I thought those little devils would wait me out.
stepan_2: I saw something before they chased me. A bandit carrying a box from the churchyard, towards their camp.
stepan_2_uk: Я дещо бачив, перш ніж вони погналися за мною. Бандит ніс скриньку від цвинтаря до їхнього табору.
I saw something before they chased me. A bandit carrying a box from the churchyard, towards their camp.
stepan_box: Wooden. Sealed. Wrapped in church cloth, the white kind with the stitched border. They weren't stealing grain this time. The captain told them not to open it.
stepan_box_uk: Дерев'яну. Запечатану. Загорнуту в церковне полотно, біле, з вишитою облямівкою. Цього разу вони крали не зерно. Ватажок наказав її не відкривати.
Wooden. Sealed. Wrapped in church cloth, the white kind with the stitched border. They weren't stealing grain this time. The captain told them not to open it.
stepan_badge: I dropped my badge by the old cart when I ran. Brannock will have my hide if I come back without it. Would you? I'll start limping home.
stepan_badge_uk: Я загубив свій знак біля старого воза, коли тікав. Бранок з мене шкуру здере, якщо я повернуся без нього. Знайдеш? А я поки пошкандибаю додому.
I dropped my badge by the old cart when I ran. Brannock will have my hide if I come back without it. Would you? I'll start limping home.
stepan_captain_uk: Бандитам байдуже. А от ватажкові ні.
stepan_hide: Get down! They're still out there!
stepan_hide_uk: Get down! They're still out there!
stepan_ready: Go on, tell the sergeant. He'll want it from you, not me.
stepan_ready_uk: Іди, розкажи сержантові. Він захоче почути це від тебе, а не від мене.
Go on, tell the sergeant. He'll want it from you, not me.
stepan_hello: Thanks again, stranger. I owe you a drink at the Ladle.
stepan_hello_uk: Ще раз дякую, чужинцю. За мною кухоль у «Кривому Черпаку».
Thanks again, stranger. I owe you a drink at the Ladle.
stepan_after: Badge back on my chest, leg in a splint. Brannock says I'm a fool. He's smiling when he says it, though.
stepan_after_uk: Знак знову на грудях, нога в лубку. Бранок каже, що я дурень. Але каже це з усмішкою.
Badge back on my chest, leg in a splint. Brannock says I'm a fool. He's smiling when he says it, though.
aldric_meet_1: Light be with you, stranger. You arrive armed, exhausted, and without a name I recognize. Let us begin with the simplest question: are you here to harm anyone?
aldric_meet_1_uk: Світло з тобою, чужинцю. Ти прийшов озброєний, виснажений і з ім'ям, якого я не знаю. Почнімо з найпростішого питання: ти прийшов комусь зашкодити?
Light be with you, stranger. You arrive armed, exhausted, and without a name I recognize. Let us begin with the simplest question: are you here to harm anyone?
aldric_meet_accident: Accidents do not usually carry weapons. Still, I will take you at your word until you give me reason not to.
aldric_meet_accident_uk: Випадковості зазвичай не носять зброї. Та все ж я повірю тобі на слово, доки ти не дасиш мені причини не вірити.
Accidents do not usually carry weapons. Still, I will take you at your word until you give me reason not to.
aldric_meet_soldier: A soldier's answer. I have heard it from good men and from very bad ones. We shall see which you are.
aldric_meet_soldier_uk: Солдатська відповідь. Я чув її від добрих людей і від дуже лихих. Побачимо, хто ти.
A soldier's answer. I have heard it from good men and from very bad ones. We shall see which you are.
aldric_town: Northvale was built by farmers, not kings. The church keeps the calendar, the guard keeps the road, and the fields keep everyone alive. Now all three have begun to fail.
aldric_town_uk: Нортвейл збудували фермери, а не королі. Церква веде календар, варта стереже дорогу, а поля годують усіх. Тепер усе троє почали підводити.
Northvale was built by farmers, not kings. The church keeps the calendar, the guard keeps the road, and the fields keep everyone alive. Now all three have begun to fail.
aldric_bells: The bells rang without a hand upon the rope. I checked the tower myself. I have no explanation that I am willing to call truth.
aldric_bells_uk: Дзвони дзвонили, хоч ніхто не торкався мотузки. Я сам оглянув дзвіницю. У мене немає пояснення, яке я наважився б назвати правдою.
The bells rang without a hand upon the rope. I checked the tower myself. I have no explanation that I am willing to call truth.
aldric_weapon: I have seen enchanted steel. I have seen fire called from a staff. Your weapon is neither. It speaks once and leaves a wound before the eye can follow the shot.
aldric_weapon_uk: Я бачив зачаровану сталь. Бачив вогонь, викликаний з палиці. Твоя зброя ні те, ні інше. Вона говорить один раз і лишає рану раніше, ніж око встигне побачити постріл.
I have seen enchanted steel. I have seen fire called from a staff. Your weapon is neither. It speaks once and leaves a wound before the eye can follow the shot.
aldric_mushrooms: Do not bring strange fungi into the church. If you have already touched one, tell me what you saw. I will not promise to understand it, but I will listen.
aldric_mushrooms_uk: Не носи дивних грибів до церкви. Якщо вже торкався, розкажи, що бачив. Не обіцяю зрозуміти, але вислухаю.
Do not bring strange fungi into the church. If you have already touched one, tell me what you saw. I will not promise to understand it, but I will listen.
aldric_crypt: The crypt is sealed for safety. That much is true. Do not ask me for the rest of it today.
aldric_crypt_uk: Склеп запечатано заради безпеки. Це правда. Решти сьогодні не питай.
The crypt is sealed for safety. That much is true. Do not ask me for the rest of it today.
aldric_fragment: Not on the altar. Not anywhere near the altar. Wrap it in linen and keep it from your skin. Olek says the grass dies where that black stuff falls.
aldric_fragment_uk: Тільки не на вівтар. І навіть не біля нього. Загорни в полотно і не торкайся шкірою. Олек каже, що там, де падає та чорна гидота, трава гине.
Not on the altar. Not anywhere near the altar. Wrap it in linen and keep it from your skin. Olek says the grass dies where that black stuff falls.
aldric_after_captain: I judged you too quickly. That is a sin of pride, and I shall own it. But trust is not a switch that turns on because a man has done one good deed.
aldric_after_captain_uk: Я надто поспішно тебе засудив. Це гріх гордині, і я його визнаю. Але довіра не вмикається, мов перемикач, лише тому, що людина зробила одну добру справу.
I judged you too quickly. That is a sin of pride, and I shall own it. But trust is not a switch that turns on because a man has done one good deed.
aldric_records_1: If you have read the old records, then you know why I feared your questions. There are stories in these pages that should have been forgotten. I do not know whether they are warnings, lies, or the mistakes of frightened men.
aldric_records_1_uk: Якщо ти прочитав старі записи, то знаєш, чому я боявся твоїх питань. На цих сторінках є історії, які мали б забутися. Я не знаю, чи це застереження, брехня, чи помилки наляканих людей.

If you have read the old records, then you know why I feared your questions. There are stories in these pages that should have been forgotten. I do not know whether they are warnings, lies, or the mistakes of frightened men.
aldric_records_2: A handful, over three hundred years. Travellers no one saw arrive, in clothes no one could name. The records do not say where they went. I do not know if they say anything about you.
aldric_records_2_uk: Кілька за триста років. Мандрівники, яких ніхто не бачив, як вони прийшли, в одязі, якому ніхто не знав назви. Записи не кажуть, куди вони поділися. І я не знаю, чи кажуть вони щось про тебе.
A handful, over three hundred years. Travellers no one saw arrive, in clothes no one could name. The records do not say where they went. I do not know if they say anything about you.
aldric_records_keep: Thank you. Not for my sake. For theirs. Frightened people burn things.
aldric_records_keep_uk: Дякую. Не заради мене. Заради них. Налякані люди палять.
Thank you. Not for my sake. For theirs. Frightened people burn things.
aldric_wolves_why: Not in daylight. Not without hunger. Not without reason.
aldric_wolves_why_uk: Не вдень. Не без голоду. Не без причини.
Not in daylight. Not without hunger. Not without reason.
aldric_wolves_go: Go carefully. And if you find anything strange about them, anything at all, I want to hear of it.
aldric_wolves_go_uk: Іди обережно. І якщо помітиш у них щось дивне, хоч що-небудь, я хочу про це знати.
Go carefully. And if you find anything strange about them, anything at all, I want to hear of it.
aldric_wolves_grey: Grey. ...No. I will not guess aloud. Guesses spread faster than sickness in a valley like this one.
aldric_wolves_grey_uk: Сіре. ...Ні. Я не гадатиму вголос. У такій долині здогадки ширяться швидше за хворобу.
Grey. ...No. I will not guess aloud. Guesses spread faster than sickness in a valley like this one.
aldric_letter_margin: And in the margin: the bells rang before the graves opened. So. Maybell is frightened. Understandably so. But she has heard the bells as well?
aldric_letter_margin_uk: А на березі приписано: дзвони задзвонили раніше, ніж відкрилися могили. Отже. Мейбел налякана. І не дивно. Але вона теж чула дзвони?
And in the margin: the bells rang before the graves opened. So. Maybell is frightened. Understandably so. But she has heard the bells as well?
aldric_letter_rope: Everyone who was awake. The trouble is that the bell rope was hanging untouched.
aldric_letter_rope_uk: Усі, хто не спав. Біда в тому, що мотузка дзвона висіла неторкана.
Everyone who was awake. The trouble is that the bell rope was hanging untouched.
aldric_letter_order: It matters which came first. If the bells woke the dead, that is one kind of story. If the dead woke the bells... that is another.
aldric_letter_order_uk: Важливо, що було першим. Якщо дзвони розбудили мертвих, це одна історія. А якщо мертві розбудили дзвони... то зовсім інша.
It matters which came first. If the bells woke the dead, that is one kind of story. If the dead woke the bells... that is another.
aldric_letter_end: Take these. For the sick, I tell the brothers. Mostly for the foolish who walk into wolf country. And, stranger... hold out your hands. There is a prayer of mending the brothers learn. Let us see if it answers you.
aldric_letter_end_uk: Візьми це. Для хворих, кажу я братам. Здебільшого для нерозважних, що ходять вовчими стежками. І, чужинцю... простягни руки. Брати вивчають молитву зцілення. Подивимося, чи відгукнеться вона тобі.

Take these. For the sick, I tell the brothers. Mostly for the foolish who walk into wolf country. And, stranger... hold out your hands. There is a prayer of mending the brothers learn. Let us see if it answers you.
nv_churchyard_offer: I need you to look at the graves. The brothers will not go near them, and I will not send an unarmed man into that darkness.
nv_churchyard_offer_uk: Мені треба, щоб ти оглянув могили. Брати не підходять до них, а я не пошлю неозброєну людину в ту темряву.
I need you to look at the graves. The brothers will not go near them, and I will not send an unarmed man into that darkness.
aldric_churchyard_plan: When you phrase it that way, it sounds a poor plan.
aldric_churchyard_plan_uk: Коли ти кажеш це так, план звучить не надто добре.
When you phrase it that way, it sounds a poor plan.
aldric_churchyard_go: The cemetery lies behind the church. Three graves. Look closely, touch nothing you need not touch, and come back to me.
aldric_churchyard_go_uk: Цвинтар за церквою. Три могили. Роздивися уважно, не торкайся нічого без потреби і повертайся до мене.
The cemetery lies behind the church. Three graves. Look closely, touch nothing you need not touch, and come back to me.
nv_churchyard_done: You were gone long enough to worry me. Tell me what you found.
nv_churchyard_done_uk: Тебе не було так довго, що я почав хвилюватися. Розкажи, що знайшов.
You were gone long enough to worry me. Tell me what you found.
aldric_churchyard_subject: ...The brothers will want to know the graves are quiet, at least for tonight. Here, take this key. The records cabinet in the south aisle. I would rather you read than guess.
aldric_churchyard_subject_uk: ...Братам треба знати, що могили спокійні, бодай цієї ночі. Ось, візьми ключ. Шафа із записами в південній наві. Краще читай, ніж гадай.
...The brothers will want to know the graves are quiet, at least for tonight. Here, take this key. The records cabinet in the south aisle. I would rather you read than guess.
aldric_candles_why: Kobolds steal things they do not understand. Sometimes they keep them. Sometimes they eat them. I would rather not discover which.
aldric_candles_why_uk: Кобольди крадуть те, чого не розуміють. Іноді залишають собі. Іноді з'їдають. Я волів би не з'ясовувати, що саме.
Kobolds steal things they do not understand. Sometimes they keep them. Sometimes they eat them. I would rather not discover which.
aldric_candles_go: Six candles. The mine is west, at the end of the cart track. They will be wearing them, I am told. On their heads.
aldric_candles_go_uk: Шість свічок. Шахта на заході, наприкінці колії. Кажуть, вони їх носять. На головах.
Six candles. The mine is west, at the end of the cart track. They will be wearing them, I am told. On their heads.
aldric_candles_shard: The same as the graves. In the mine. ...I cannot explain why. I wish I could tell you that I can.
aldric_candles_shard_uk: Те саме, що й на могилах. У шахті. ...Я не можу пояснити чому. Хотів би я сказати тобі, що можу.
The same as the graves. In the mine. ...I cannot explain why. I wish I could tell you that I can.
nv_road_offer: Brannock tells me the captain is dead and the road east is open. Open is a generous word. Something has been coming down that road at night.
nv_road_offer_uk: Бранок каже, що ватажок мертвий і дорога на схід відкрита. «Відкрита» — щедре слово. Щось ходить тією дорогою вночі.
Brannock tells me the captain is dead and the road east is open. Open is a generous word. Something has been coming down that road at night.
aldric_road_what: Darkwood. A forest that was quiet for a hundred years and is not quiet now.
aldric_road_what_uk: Темноліс. Ліс, що мовчав сто років, а тепер не мовчить.
Darkwood. A forest that was quiet for a hundred years and is not quiet now.
aldric_road_go: The old gate past Maybell's fields. Go, and come back to me. I would like you to come back.
aldric_road_go_uk: Стара брама за полями Мейбел. Іди і повертайся до мене. Я хотів би, щоб ти повернувся.
The old gate past Maybell's fields. Go, and come back to me. I would like you to come back.
nv_road_done: A strip of black cloth on a branch, and wolves that do not fear a rifle. Whatever began in this valley is not finished here.
nv_road_done_uk: Клапоть чорного полотна на гілці і вовки, що не бояться рушниці. Те, що почалося в цій долині, тут не скінчилося.
A strip of black cloth on a branch, and wolves that do not fear a rifle. Whatever began in this valley is not finished here.
aldric_road_end: The road to Darkwood is yours, when you choose to take it. Finish what you must here first, if you wish. Northvale will still be standing. I think.
aldric_road_end_uk: Дорога до Темнолісу твоя, коли вирішиш нею піти. Якщо хочеш, спершу заверши тут свої справи. Нортвейл ще стоятиме. Гадаю.
The road to Darkwood is yours, when you choose to take it. Finish what you must here first, if you wish. Northvale will still be standing. I think.
maybell_hello2: Mind the mud, and mind the chickens.
maybell_hello2_uk: Обережно з багнюкою. І з курками.
Mind the mud, and mind the chickens.
maybell_family: My children are asleep before dark now. Not because they're tired. Because if they're in bed, I can pretend they're safe for another hour.
maybell_family_uk: Мої діти тепер лягають спати ще до темряви. Не тому, що втомилися. Просто коли вони в ліжку, я можу ще годинку вдавати, що вони в безпеці.
My children are asleep before dark now. Not because they're tired. Because if they're in bed, I can pretend they're safe for another hour.
maybell_bandits: They took the grain, but that isn't the strangest part. One of them apologized to me. Imagine that. A bandit, apologizing while carrying off your winter food.
maybell_bandits_uk: Вони забрали зерно, але це ще не найдивніше. Один із них перепросив у мене. Уявляєш? Бандит перепрошує, поки виносить твої зимові запаси.
They took the grain, but that isn't the strangest part. One of them apologized to me. Imagine that. A bandit, apologizing while carrying off your winter food.
maybell_church: Aldric says prayer will help. I hope he's right. I also hope somebody fixes that fence, because prayer doesn't keep wolves out of a chicken coop.
maybell_church_uk: Алдрік каже, що молитва допоможе. Сподіваюся, він правий. А ще сподіваюся, що хтось полагодить той паркан, бо молитва не втримає вовків від курника.
Aldric says prayer will help. I hope he's right. I also hope somebody fixes that fence, because prayer doesn't keep wolves out of a chicken coop.
maybell_pattern: I've been walking the field edges at dusk. The grey is worst along the old paths: the church road, the track to the oak, the cemetery wall. Places people walk at night. I don't know what it means. Help me understand it, when you can.
maybell_pattern_uk: Я надвечір обходжу краї полів. Сірого найбільше вздовж старих стежок: церковна дорога, стежка до дуба, цвинтарна стіна. Там, де люди ходять уночі. Не знаю, що це означає. Допоможи мені зрозуміти, коли зможеш.

I've been walking the field edges at dusk. The grey is worst along the old paths: the church road, the track to the oak, the cemetery wall. Places people walk at night. I don't know what it means. Help me understand it, when you can.
maybell_after_farm: The children ate properly last night, the first time in a week. I won't forget it.
maybell_after_farm_uk: Учора діти вперше за тиждень нормально поїли. Я цього не забуду.
The children ate properly last night, the first time in a week. I won't forget it.
maybell_after_captain: They say the captain's dead. I heard the shots from the house. I wanted to run outside, then I remembered I had two children behind me. I'm glad you were there.
maybell_after_captain_uk: Кажуть, ватажок мертвий. Я чула постріли з хати. Хотіла вибігти надвір, а тоді згадала, що за мною двоє дітей. Я рада, що ти був там.
They say the captain's dead. I heard the shots from the house. I wanted to run outside, then I remembered I had two children behind me. I'm glad you were there.
maybell_grain_go: Thank you. And please don't shoot the chickens. They're the only things around here still laying eggs.
maybell_grain_go_uk: Дякую. І, будь ласка, не стріляй у курей. Тільки вони тут ще несуть яйця.
Thank you. And please don't shoot the chickens. They're the only things around here still laying eggs.
maybell_grain_grey: Wait. This one's grey, and damp. It was dry when I stored it, I swear it was. Wheat doesn't go grey in a week. Not in my granary.
maybell_grain_grey_uk: Стривай. Цей сірий і вологий. Він був сухий, коли я його складала, присягаюся. Пшениця не сіріє за тиждень. Тільки не в моїй клуні.
Wait. This one's grey, and damp. It was dry when I stored it, I swear it was. Wheat doesn't go grey in a week. Not in my granary.
maybell_letter_go: Don't read it. ...Well, you'll read it anyway. Just don't tell me you did.
maybell_letter_go_uk: Не читай його. ...Ну, однаково прочитаєш. Тільки не кажи мені.
Don't read it. ...Well, you'll read it anyway. Just don't tell me you did.
marta_hello: Come in, stranger. You look like you've walked through a storm and argued with it. I've got stew, a bed, and three different explanations for what happened to the church bells.
marta_hello_uk: Заходь, чужинцю. Маєш такий вигляд, ніби пройшов крізь бурю і ще й посварився з нею. У мене є юшка, ліжко і три різні пояснення того, що сталося з церковними дзвонами.
Come in, stranger. You look like you've walked through a storm and argued with it. I've got stew, a bed, and three different explanations for what happened to the church bells.
marta_hello2: Back again? The stew's the same. The gossip's fresher.
marta_hello2_uk: Знову ти? Юшка та сама. Плітки свіжіші.
Back again? The stew's the same. The gossip's fresher.
marta_rumours: One man says the dead walked. Another says the priest is hiding something. A third says the bandits paid for the church box. I believe all three are lying about at least one detail.
marta_rumours_uk: Один каже, що мертві ходили. Другий каже, що священник щось приховує. Третій каже, що бандити заплатили за церковну скриньку. Гадаю, всі троє брешуть принаймні в одній дрібниці.
One man says the dead walked. Another says the priest is hiding something. A third says the bandits paid for the church box. I believe all three are lying about at least one detail.
marta_vesper: That sleepy boy? He asks questions, fixes little machines, and pays for meals with things I cannot identify. He's harmless, I think. But he looks at the river like it owes him money.
marta_vesper_uk: Той сонний хлопець? Ставить питання, лагодить маленькі машинки і платить за їжу речами, яких я не можу впізнати. Гадаю, він нешкідливий. Але дивиться на річку так, ніби вона винна йому грошей.
That sleepy boy? He asks questions, fixes little machines, and pays for meals with things I cannot identify. He's harmless, I think. But he looks at the river like it owes him money.
marta_room: A traveller took that room the week before the bells. Paid in silver, asked about the church, and was gone one morning with the bed still made. I locked it. Don't ask me for the key, love. I'm not ready for what's in there.
marta_room_uk: Ту кімнату за тиждень до дзвонів винайняв мандрівник. Заплатив сріблом, розпитував про церкву, а одного ранку зник, і ліжко так і лишилося застеленим. Я її замкнула. Не проси ключа, любий. Я ще не готова до того, що там.

A traveller took that room the week before the bells. Paid in silver, asked about the church, and was gone one morning with the bed still made. I locked it. Don't ask me for the key, love. I'm not ready for what's in there.
marta_bells: Who was in the village that night? Everyone you'd expect. Olek at the graves, Aldric at his prayers, that sleepy boy by the oak. And one more. I'll tell you about the one more when you've earned a second bowl of stew.
marta_bells_uk: Хто був у селі тієї ночі? Усі, кого й слід чекати. Олек біля могил, Алдрік на молитві, той сонний хлопець біля дуба. І ще один. Про того «ще одного» розповім, коли заслужиш другу миску юшки.

Who was in the village that night? Everyone you'd expect. Olek at the graves, Aldric at his prayers, that sleepy boy by the oak. And one more. I'll tell you about the one more when you've earned a second bowl of stew.
marta_rest: Sit, warm your boots. Nobody will rob you while Marta's watching. Well, nobody but Marta.
marta_rest_uk: Сідай, грій чоботи. Ніхто тебе не обкраде, поки Марта дивиться. Ну, ніхто, крім Марти.
Sit, warm your boots. Nobody will rob you while Marta's watching. Well, nobody but Marta.
marta_after_captain: I heard the cheering. Then I heard the guards arguing about who gets credit. That's how you know the village is returning to normal.
marta_after_captain_uk: Я чула радісні вигуки. А потім чула, як вартові сперечаються, кому дістанеться слава. Ось так і знаєш, що село повертається до звичного життя.
I heard the cheering. Then I heard the guards arguing about who gets credit. That's how you know the village is returning to normal.
danylo_hello: Don't put that rifle on my anvil. I don't care how much you trust it. I don't know what it's made of, and I'd rather keep my fingers.
danylo_hello_uk: Не клади цю рушницю на моє ковадло. Мені байдуже, як ти їй довіряєш. Я не знаю, з чого вона зроблена, і волію зберегти пальці.
Don't put that rifle on my anvil. I don't care how much you trust it. I don't know what it's made of, and I'd rather keep my fingers.
danylo_hello2: Rifle stays off the anvil. Everything else, I can work with.
danylo_hello2_uk: Рушниця подалі від ковадла. З усім іншим я впораюся.
Rifle stays off the anvil. Everything else, I can work with.
danylo_weapon: I can make steel, iron, nails, and a decent spearhead. I can't make whatever tiny parts are inside that weapon. If you want me to learn, bring me broken parts, not a lecture.
danylo_weapon_uk: Я вмію робити сталь, залізо, цвяхи і пристойний наконечник списа. Але не ті крихітні деталі, що всередині твоєї зброї. Хочеш, щоб я навчився, неси мені зламані деталі, а не лекції.
I can make steel, iron, nails, and a decent spearhead. I can't make whatever tiny parts are inside that weapon. If you want me to learn, bring me broken parts, not a lecture.
danylo_cursed_1: Folk say it's cursed. Show me it's not. Does it ever go off on its own?
danylo_cursed_1_uk: Люди кажуть, вона проклята. Доведи, що ні. Вона колись стріляє сама?
Folk say it's cursed. Show me it's not. Does it ever go off on its own?
danylo_cursed_trigger: Then it's less cursed than my nephew's crossbow. Fine. I'll look at it. From here.
danylo_cursed_trigger_uk: Тоді вона менш проклята, ніж арбалет мого небожа. Гаразд. Я на неї подивлюся. Звідси.
Then it's less cursed than my nephew's crossbow. Fine. I'll look at it. From here.
danylo_cursed_springs: Iron and springs I understand. The rest I'll learn. Bring me broken parts some day.
danylo_cursed_springs_uk: Залізо і пружини я розумію. Решти навчуся. Принось мені колись зламані деталі.
Iron and springs I understand. The rest I'll learn. Bring me broken parts some day.
danylo_copy: Remember that empty casing you left on my bench? I made three like it from brass. They're wrong, all of them, but less wrong each time. Give me a year and Northvale will make its own thunder.
danylo_copy_uk: Пам'ятаєш порожню гільзу, яку ти лишив на моєму верстаті? Я зробив з латуні три такі самі. Усі неправильні, але щоразу менш неправильні. Дай мені рік, і Нортвейл робитиме власний грім.
Remember that empty casing you left on my bench? I made three like it from brass. They're wrong, all of them, but less wrong each time. Give me a year and Northvale will make its own thunder.
danylo_after_help: Those bandits took half my tools. You got them back. I'll repair your gear for less. That's gratitude, not charity. Don't get used to it.
danylo_after_help_uk: Ті бандити забрали половину мого інструменту. Ти його повернув. Лагодитиму твоє спорядження дешевше. Це вдячність, а не милостиня. Не звикай.
Those bandits took half my tools. You got them back. I'll repair your gear for less. That's gratitude, not charity. Don't get used to it.
iva_hello: Are you a knight? Your armour is strange. Do you sleep in it? Does the gun need food? My father says not to ask you questions, so I have only three more.
iva_hello_uk: Ти лицар? У тебе дивні обладунки. Ти в них спиш? А рушниця їсть? Тато каже не ставити тобі питань, тож у мене лишилося тільки три.
Are you a knight? Your armour is strange. Do you sleep in it? Does the gun need food? My father says not to ask you questions, so I have only three more.
iva_hello2: You again! Did you sleep in the armour? You did, didn't you.
iva_hello2_uk: Знову ти! Ти спав в обладунках? Спав, так?
You again! Did you sleep in the armour? You did, didn't you.
iva_church: I heard the bell when I was asleep. Mum said it was a dream. But our dog hid under the table, and he doesn't dream about bells.
iva_church_uk: Я чула дзвін, коли спала. Мама сказала, що мені наснилося. Але наш пес сховався під стіл, а йому дзвони не сняться.
I heard the bell when I was asleep. Mum said it was a dream. But our dog hid under the table, and he doesn't dream about bells.
iva_vesper: VesPer says his flying thing can see the top of the church. I told him it should look inside the bell tower. He got quiet and told me not to climb it.
iva_vesper_uk: ВесПер каже, що його літаюча штука бачить дах церкви. Я сказала, що хай краще подивиться всередину дзвіниці. А він замовк і сказав мені туди не лазити.
VesPer says his flying thing can see the top of the church. I told him it should look inside the bell tower. He got quiet and told me not to climb it.
iva_gun: Father says it eats little metal seeds. If it ever gets hungry, I have buttons.
iva_gun_uk: Тато каже, що вона їсть маленьке металеве насіння. Якщо вона зголодніє, у мене є ґудзики.
Father says it eats little metal seeds. If it ever gets hungry, I have buttons.
iva_after_captain: Does this mean the bandits are gone? Can we play outside again? I don't want to play near the churchyard, though.
iva_after_captain_uk: Це означає, що бандитів більше немає? Можна знову гратися надворі? Тільки біля цвинтаря я гратися не хочу.
Does this mean the bandits are gone? Can we play outside again? I don't want to play near the churchyard, though.
olek_hello: I keep the graves. Forty years I've done it. I know who belongs in each one. Three of them are empty now, and I did not open them.
olek_hello_uk: Я доглядаю могили. Сорок років уже. Знаю, хто в якій лежить. Три з них тепер порожні, і не я їх розкопав.
I keep the graves. Forty years I've done it. I know who belongs in each one. Three of them are empty now, and I did not open them.
olek_hello2: Still breathing? Good. I've enough work.
olek_hello2_uk: Ще дихаєш? Добре. Роботи мені й так вистачає.
Still breathing? Good. I've enough work.
olek_bells: The rope was still. I saw it with my own eyes. The bell moved anyway. Don't ask me how. I'm old, not a liar.
olek_bells_uk: Мотузка не рухалася. Я бачив на власні очі. А дзвін однаково гойдався. Не питай як. Я старий, але не брехун.
The rope was still. I saw it with my own eyes. The bell moved anyway. Don't ask me how. I'm old, not a liar.
olek_night: There was a light near the rear wall. I thought it was a lantern. Then it went straight up, like a spark rising from a fire. I never saw who carried it.
olek_night_uk: Біля задньої стіни було світло. Я подумав, що то ліхтар. А тоді воно злетіло просто вгору, як іскра з багаття. Хто його ніс, я так і не побачив.
There was a light near the rear wall. I thought it was a lantern. Then it went straight up, like a spark rising from a fire. I never saw who carried it.
olek_crow: That crow sits on the Harrow stone every morning. Every evening too. Harrow's grave is one of the three. Crows remember faces. Maybe it remembers his.
olek_crow_uk: Та ворона щоранку сидить на камені Гарроу. І щовечора теж. Могила Гарроу одна з тих трьох. Ворони пам'ятають обличчя. Може, вона пам'ятає його.
That crow sits on the Harrow stone every morning. Every evening too. Harrow's grave is one of the three. Crows remember faces. Maybe it remembers his.
olek_after_graves: You found the black stuff? Keep it away from your skin. I don't know what it is, but the grass died where it fell.
olek_after_graves_uk: Ти знайшов ту чорну гидоту? Тримай її подалі від шкіри. Не знаю, що це, але там, де вона впала, трава загинула.
You found the black stuff? Keep it away from your skin. I don't know what it is, but the grass died where it fell.
captain_intro_1: So the church's new miracle has come to collect its debts. Tell me, stranger, does that iron stick of yours make thunder every time, or only when you're frightened?
captain_intro_1_uk: Отже, нове церковне диво прийшло збирати борги. Скажи-но, чужинцю, твоя залізна палиця гримить щоразу чи тільки тоді, коли ти боїшся?
So the church's new miracle has come to collect its debts. Tell me, stranger, does that iron stick of yours make thunder every time, or only when you're frightened?
captain_laugh: Ha! Drop it, he says. Brannock sends me a comedian.
captain_laugh_uk: Ха! «Кинь», каже він. Бранок прислав мені блазня.
Ha! Drop it, he says. Brannock sends me a comedian.
captain_box: Careful. You talk about things that aren't yours to know. That box paid for half this camp.
captain_box_uk: Обережно. Ти говориш про те, чого тобі знати не годиться. Та скринька оплатила пів табору.
Careful. You talk about things that aren't yours to know. That box paid for half this camp.
captain_who: ...Nobody. A face in a hood with good silver. You'll get nothing more out of me but iron.
captain_who_uk: ...Ніхто. Обличчя під каптуром і добре срібло. Більше ти від мене нічого не дістанеш, крім заліза.
...Nobody. A face in a hood with good silver. You'll get nothing more out of me but iron.
th_grey_wolf: Black gums. And this grey patch... that isn't mange.
th_grey_wolf_uk: Чорні ясна. І ця сіра пляма... це не короста.
Black gums. And this grey patch... that isn't mange.
th_open_grave: Opened from inside. The lid was pushed, not pried.
th_open_grave_uk: Відкрито зсередини. Плиту виштовхнули, а не підважили.
Opened from inside. The lid was pushed, not pried.
th_mushrooms: That glow... like the mushroom in the forest. Not the same shape. Not the same colour. Close enough to make my stomach turn.
th_mushrooms_uk: Це світіння... як той гриб у лісі. Не та форма. Не той колір. Але досить схоже, щоб у мене звело живіт.
That glow... like the mushroom in the forest. Not the same shape. Not the same colour. Close enough to make my stomach turn.
th_shard: The same grey as the graves. All the way out here.
th_shard_uk: Та сама сірість, що й на могилах. Аж тут.
The same grey as the graves. All the way out here.
th_black_cloth: Black cloth, the same residue. Something walked this road before me.
th_black_cloth_uk: Чорне полотно, той самий наліт. Хтось ішов цією дорогою переді мною.
Black cloth, the same residue. Something walked this road before me.
th_fragment: Cold. Too cold for metal that's been in a man's pocket.
th_fragment_uk: Холодний. Надто холодний як для металу, що лежав у когось у кишені.
Cold. Too cold for metal that's been in a man's pocket.
th_battery: A date? Scratched into the casing. Numbers like ours.
th_battery_uk: Дата? Видряпана на корпусі. Цифри, як у нас.
A date? Scratched into the casing. Numbers like ours.
vesper_hello2: О, це ти. Добре. Я вже думав, знову бандити, а в мене скінчилися пояснення.
Oh, it's you. Good. I thought it was the bandits again, and I've run out of explanations.
vesper_past: Я був фермером. Поля, робота, звичайні справи. А у вільний час літав на FPV-дронах. Не дуже героїчно, зате було весело.
I was a farmer. Fields, work, ordinary things. In my free time I flew FPV drones. Not very heroic, but it was fun.
vesper_arrive: Це довга історія. Я пам'ятаю воду, дивне світло і те, що все пішло не за планом. Решта... поки не хочу про це.
It's a long story. I remember water, a strange light, and everything going wrong. The rest... I don't want to talk about it yet.
vesper_rifle: Я бачив таку зброю раніше. Не тут. І коли я її побачив у тебе, я зрозумів, що, можливо, ти теж не звідси.
I've seen a weapon like that before. Not here. When I saw yours, I realized you might not be from here either.
vesper_drone_topic: Дрон — це не магія. Це пропелери, електроніка, батарея і купа шансів щось зламати. Але з неба видно те, чого з дороги не помітиш.
A drone isn't magic. It's propellers, electronics, a battery, and plenty of ways to break something. But from the sky you can see things you'd miss from the road.
vesper_mushroom: Ти теж бачив гриб? Не той, що росте під церквою. Інший. Яскравий. Я довго думав, що просто втратив свідомість.
You saw a mushroom too? Not the one growing under the church. A different one. A bright one. For a long time, I thought I'd simply passed out.
vesper_cloth: А, це? Мода з тих часів, коли мода ще не померла.
Oh, that? Fashion from before fashion died.
vesper_map: Це не дороги. Ну, не ті дороги. Це місця, де я бачив світло. Не питай, яке світло.
Those aren't roads. Well, not those roads. They're places where I've seen the light. Don't ask what light.
vesper_honest: Дякую. Я знаю, що постійно жартую. Просто якщо перестану, доведеться думати про те, де я мав би бути зараз.
Thanks. I know I joke all the time. It's just that if I stop, I'll have to think about where I'm supposed to be right now.
vesper_goodbye: Не геройствуй там, добре? Я вже втратив достатньо речей у цьому світі. Не хочу втрачати ще й єдину людину, яка розуміє мої жарти.
Don't play the hero out there, okay? I've lost enough things in this world already. I don't want to lose the only person who understands my jokes, either.
vesper_gathering: Я тут просто стою. Алдрік хоче щось сказати, і, здається, щось урочисте.
I'm just standing here. Aldric wants to say something, and it sounds solemn.
vesper_dusk_1: Достатньо довго, щоб перестати рахувати дні.
Long enough to stop counting days.
vesper_dusk_2: Думаю, шлях є. Не знаю, чи це той шлях, який нам потрібен.
I think there's a way. I don't know if it's the way we want.
vesper_dusk_3: Це означає, що нам треба рухатися далі.
It means we should keep moving.
vesper_road: Я пошлю дрон уперед. Якщо повернеться, знатимемо, що там є про що хвилюватися.
I'll send the drone ahead. If it comes back, we'll know there's something worth worrying about.
vesper_drone_dance: Я також міг би стати професійним танцюристом. Деякі плани краще не перевіряти.
I could also have become a professional dancer. Some plans are better left untested.
vesper_drone_go: Дуб видно з усього села. Підійди до стовбура, натисни F і лізь угору. Тільки не дивись униз. Я от подивився.
You can see the oak from the whole village. Walk up to the trunk, press F and climb. Just don't look down. I did.
vesper_drone_rec: Стоп. Модуль запису ще працює. Дивись... це цвинтар уночі.
Wait. The recording module still works. Look... that's the cemetery at night.
vesper_drone_rec_2: Дзвін гойдається. А мотузка висить нерухомо. І біля задньої стіни... хтось стоїть. Або щось. Або це просто глюк.
